_note: General educational reference for an academic project. Not prescribing information and not medical advice.

drugs.name: Paracetamol
drugs.used_for: Fever and mild to moderate pain
drugs.common_side_effects: Usually well tolerated at normal doses; nausea is uncommon
drugs.caution: Overdose can seriously damage the liver; check other products for hidden paracetamol

drugs.name: Ibuprofen
drugs.caution: Usually taken after food; may not suit people with stomach ulcers, kidney disease or some heart conditions

drugs.name: Diclofenac
drugs.used_for: Pain and inflammation, e.g. joint or muscle pain
drugs.common_side_effects: Stomach upset, injection-site pain for injections

drugs.name: Amoxicillin
drugs.used_for: Bacterial infections such as some throat, ear and chest infections
drugs.caution: Not for people allergic to penicillin; finish the course as directed

drugs.name: Azithromycin
drugs.used_for: Certain bacterial respiratory and skin infections
drugs.caution: Often given as a short 3 to 5 day course

drugs.name: Cefixime
drugs.used_for: Certain bacterial infections, e.g. urinary or respiratory
drugs.caution: Easily confused with Cefuroxime in handwriting

drugs.name: Cefuroxime
drugs.caution: Easily confused with Cefixime in handwriting

drugs.name: Metronidazole
drugs.caution: Alcohol should be avoided; easily confused with Metformin

drugs.name: Cetirizine
drugs.common_side_effects: Drowsiness in some people, dry mouth

drugs.name: Hydroxyzine
drugs.caution: Easily confused with Hydralazine, a blood-pressure drug

drugs.name: Ambroxol
drugs.used_for: Loosening thick mucus in productive cough
drugs.caution: Usually a syrup measured in ml

drugs.name: ORS
drugs.used_for: Replacing fluids and salts lost in diarrhoea or vomiting
drugs.caution: Mix with the exact volume of clean water stated on the pack

drugs.name: Metformin
drugs.caution: Usually taken with or after food; easily confused with Metronidazole

drugs.name: Amiloride
drugs.used_for: High blood pressure and fluid retention

drugs.name: Valsartan
drugs.used_for: High blood pressure and heart failure

drugs.name: Atorvastatin
drugs.caution: Report unexplained muscle pain to a doctor

drugs.name: Clopidogrel
drugs.used_for: Preventing blood clots after heart attack or stroke

drugs.name: Prednisolone
drugs.common_side_effects: Increased appetite, mood changes, raised blood sugar
drugs.caution: Courses should not be stopped suddenly without medical advice; easily confused with Prednisone

drugs.name: Folic Acid
drugs.used_for: Folate deficiency and before or during pregnancy

drugs.name: Vitamin D3
drugs.caution: 60000 IU strengths are usually weekly, not daily
